title: Lychee e-Liquid Juice – Skwezed
description:
Lychee e-Liquid Juice by Skwezed –
Skwezed Lychee replicates the fruit that offers a translucent and glossy texture under its peel, similar to a grape. It offers a refreshing and sub-tart sweet taste that is deliciously hard to describe, so vape it yourself to see how much you
